diagram.07.description: The institution's identity provider signs users into its portals and apps. They call the assistant API through the API edge, which also serves the document APIs. The assistant calls model endpoints on the institution's GPU or a GPU API.
diagram.09.description: An administrator uploads files from the dashboard and selects Ingest. Dataprep extracts and chunks the content, an embedding model creates vectors, and ArangoDB stores the searchable index.
diagram.10.description: The Node.js backend sends the authenticated query to OPEA ChatQnA. Embedding and retrieval can be followed by optional reranking before generation.
diagram.11.description: Vector and BM25 rankings are fused. Optional graph traversal expands the candidate set from vector hits.
diagram.14.description: ChatQnA normalises a Kiswahili question to English. Retrieval and generation use the English corpus. The response is translated back to Kiswahili at the edge.
diagram.16.description: OKF combines concept documents and typed relationships into a versioned repository. After publication and ingestion, it can serve as a knowledge graph.
diagram.17.description: An illustrative OKF concept graph. Two procedures refer to proof of address; the renewal concept links to public handling notes.
diagram.18.description: A draft is curated in OKF Studio. The head can be tested before publication. Publication creates a version and starts ingestion, after which live corpus retrieval can be tested.
diagram.19.description: Keycloak supplies claims. GENIE.AI resolves open or closed OKF policy against the serving set, then sends the authorised graphs to retrieval.
diagram.24.description: The application uses locally selected file and index stores, then calls configured models. Institution-managed and third-party model endpoints have different data boundaries.
diagram.26.description: Instrumented GENIE.AI services send telemetry to the OpenTelemetry Collector. VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs and VictoriaTraces store the corresponding signals. Grafana visualises configured data sources.
diagram.30.description: Docker Compose, Docker Swarm and Kubernetes via Helm can all send model operations to a dedicated HTTPS GPU API. The GPU endpoint serves the configured workloads.
